reviews.text: Очень классная игра, но есть один минус - она короткая. Вместо мутаторов на дополнительное хп и урона монстров, я бы предпочел увеличить их количество для массовости как в TAB
Игра очень цепляет. Если вам нравилась миссии в старкрафте и варкрафте с обороной базы, это это точно для вас.
спокойная и интерестная игра строишь укрепления и отбиваешься от волн врагов с умом распределяй монетки и победа у тебя в кармане)))
Отличный тд в приятном визуальном стиле. Увлекательно, местами сложно.

Игра классная и конечно я могу порекомендовать, но это НЕ Kingdom в изометрии, а Защита Башен с некими элементами любимого Kingdom. Имейте это ввиду. Кампания классная и даже есть боссы и мини боссы, но стоит отметить, что каждый уровень кампании проходится по +- определенному сценарию и игрок должен придерживаться определенной идеи, которая заложена в уровнях кампании. Крутая штука - бесконечный режим. Вот тут уже игра начинает значительно меняться и напоминать любимый Kingdom! Субъективно - 7.5 из 10
На релизе играть значительно лучше! Совет всем - качайте сначала экономию! 100% стратка :)
Я их пыщ пыщ, а они пиу пиу, а потом ферма бабах, поля затоптали ироды, хороший симулятор фермера, рекомендую!
игра класс ставлю 200 несуразных выбегающих отовсюду xуecocoв из 10
Очень захватывающая игра. Не можешь успокоиться пока не пройдешь очередной раунд на золотую медаль. своеобразные шахматы в жанре defencetower.
Классика жанра! Отличная игра с той самой ламповой атмосферой.

Как любитель жанра Tower Defense могу сказать, что данная игра эталон в своем жанре, красивая графика, красочные спецэффекты и все это заправленно хорошей тактикой и большим разнообразием карт и юнитов

Ну, что сказать - отличный tower defence. Все, что надо - красочные трехмерные карты, с десяток видов башен, куча всяких монстров. И сложность хорошая - уже буквально через несколько уровней начинается прям стратегия - чтобы пройти уровень, надо экспериментировать с комбинациями башен, их расположением, порядком строительства. В общем, категорически одобряю. =)
Tower defense at its best. Being able to place your towers in such a way that it forces the baddies to take longer paths is extremely enjoyable and challenging.

This game offers a refreshing take on the tower defense genre. The levels are thoughtfully designed, requiring you to carefully consider tower placement and resource allocation. The gradual introduction of new enemy types and towers keeps the gameplay dynamic and interesting
The game shines in its ability to make you think on your feet. Each level feels like a new puzzle to solve, with enemies coming from unexpected angles and increasing in difficulty
I didn’t expect to get hooked on this game so quickly. It has that “just one more level” quality that keeps you playing late into the night

This is the best defense game I have played. The game mechanics and balance are amazing when compared against other offerings in the genre. Even after a few years, the graphics still hold up, the story is still fresh and matches the sci-fi world it was created for, and the voice acting is top quality.
Sometimes, less is more, and this game proves it. The mechanics are straightforward, but the gameplay is anything but easy

Everything about this game feels smooth and well thought out. The controls are intuitive, the graphics are clean, and the gameplay is challenging without being overwhelming. I especially like the variety of enemies, as they force you to adapt your strategy constantly

If you love planning and strategy, this game is a must-play. It rewards careful thinking and penalizes reckless tower placement. The levels are well-designed, with increasing complexity that keeps things interesting
This game strikes a perfect balance between being challenging and relaxing. The gameplay is engaging without being stressful, which makes it a great choice for unwinding after a long day
.Tower defense games have been around for a while, but this one manages to feel fresh and modern. The 3D graphics are a big part of that, as they give the game a polished look

.Best Tower Defense game ever!! Even if you've played it before, you need to play it again because the latest update has added more ways to play the levels and even has upgraded how certain towers behave
This game does a great job of challenging you without ever feeling unfair. Each level introduces new challenges, but you always have the tools to overcome them if you think strategically
The strategic depth of this game makes it highly replayable. Each level can be approached in multiple ways, depending on how you use your towers and upgrades

One of the best things about this game is its flexibility. You can play a single level in just a few minutes, or you can dive in for a longer session and tackle multiple levels. The gameplay is engaging, and the 3D visuals are a nice bonus. It’s perfect for both casual and dedicated players.
his game makes you feel like a true strategist. Every decision matters, from where you place your towers to when you upgrade them

This game doesn’t try to reinvent the wheel, but it does everything right. The tower placement mechanics are intuitive, the enemy waves are challenging, and the 3D graphics add a modern touch. It’s a straightforward but deeply satisfying experience

[quote][b][url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Asset_flip]Warning: Asset Flip![/url][/b] "Oil and Sand" is one of literally thousands of creatively bankrupt asset flips infesting Steam and lowering the average quality of all video games everywhere.[/quote] This is another scam from the Russian asset flippers, RaCaRa (once more shoving their garbage between various shell accounts to mislead gamers and hide their identity). This is a bunch of stolen low poly assets dumped on a basic tower defense game template. The "Developer" then paid for around 100 fake Steam reviews and slapped a $60 price tag on this to try scam people, trying to get YOUR money for someone else's Unity assets. This is never okay, it's highly unethical. So, "Oil and Sand" is partially or completely made up of stock assets, "borrowed" from asset stores and free asset websites. Little, if anything in this game is the creation of the "developer". While there's no up front price for this asset flip, the other problem with asset flips is that when developers aren't capable of doing their job and creating high quality assets, it's also true they can't do any of the rest of the job of a game developer either. That's definitely true for "Oil and Sand", and this kind of asset flipping never results in games that have quality or value for PC gamers. There's no English translation for the game, but that's okay. The language of bad games is universal. Now on to pricing and value for gamers. There's no initial download price, but the developer was charging $60 USD for this. Price barriers, especially on low quality products, can be a direct cause of failure. It seems like a nice gesture for the game to have no up-front cost anymore, but it also tells us that the game wasn't good enough to succeed as a paid product. This is also a bit of a slap in the face to anyone who showed enough questionable judgement to pay money for this... nobody got refunded. In terms of public reception, this failed. There's over 130 million unique gamers visiting Steam every month. SteamDB showed the game peaked at [b]only 15 concurrent players[/b]... this is a dismal public reception. This was so bad they couldn't even give it away. [quote][b][url=https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/federal-register-notices/16-cfr-part-465-trade-regulation-rule-use-consumer-reviews-testimonials-final-rule]Warning: Review Manipulation![/url][/b] This product features a number of fake positive reviews from accounts known to be in the business of review manipulation/paid reviews. They're all written in either Russian or broken English, appear at almost exactly the same time, very shortly after the product launched on Steam, and the accounts are used consistently to write fake reviews for asset flips and other cash grabs/scams. The "Positive" review score on this should be disregarded due to this blatant, unethical review manipulation. This is done to deceive and scam gamers into paying for a bad product. Due to the 2024 FTC ruling, these fake reviews are a violation of US Federal Law ([i]16 CFR § 465.2, 15 U.S.C. § 45[/i])[/quote] Since free games don't contribute to your game collector badge and other profile stuff, is this a worthwhile addition to your Steam library? Nope. This isn't worth downloading. I didn't pay money, but I still feel ripped off.
